# The Goods Lane

> The Goods Lane sells new and open-box electronics, appliances and home goods at liquidation prices, typically 30 to 70% below retail. Pick up in Mississauga or ask about delivery across the Greater Toronto Area.

- Seller: Ali Abbas
- Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Pickup around Matheson Blvd E and Hurontario St, near Square One.
- Delivery: available across the Greater Toronto Area at a reasonable charge; ask for a quote.
- Serves: Mississauga, Toronto, Brampton, Oakville, Etobicoke, Milton, Burlington, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill and the rest of the Greater Toronto Area
- Contact: Facebook Messenger https://m.me/61577549634421 or WhatsApp/text +16477706652 (https://wa.me/16477706652)

- Prices are in Canadian dollars.
